description: Explain automatic SuiteTax nexus selection, fallback or failure for sales and purchases, using transaction addresses, registration validity and override evidence. Use for general rules or a specific transaction; distinguish business-to-business and business-to-consumer treatment. Tax amounts, legal advice and record changes are outside scope.
name: netsuite-suitetax-nexus-explainer
purpose: Explain why SuiteTax selected, changed, or failed to determine the transaction nexus for sales and purchases. Use for transaction-specific or general questions about SuiteTax address sourcing, B2B/B2C classification, subsidiary tax registrations, transaction-date validity, nexus candidates, and fallback logic. Do not use as independent tax or legal advice or to invent a tax result without the required NetSuite data.
